get.description:
Turn a Kaspi outage into an honest status code instead of a 500.

A dead platform session is a 409 (the same shape the per-company integration answers
with), Kaspi refusing the request is a 400, and the service being unreachable is a 502 —
the payer can retry that one.

TenantInvoiceKaspi.description:
Raise a Kaspi Pay payment for an existing subscription invoice.

`qr` answers with a `pay.kaspi.kz` link to render as a QR or open on a phone; `invoice`
pushes a confirmation into the Kaspi app of `phone` instead. Either way the invoice is
only marked paid by the webhook — never by this response.
